documents.title: 49 CFR Part 673 - Public Transportation Agency Safety Plans
documents.why_included: Defines what a transit agency's safety plan must contain, including the safety risk management and safety assurance processes.

documents.title: 49 CFR Part 674 - State Safety Oversight
documents.why_included: Defines how states oversee rail transit safety, including the accident notification and investigation duties after an incident.

documents.title: Public Transportation Agency Safety Plans - Final Rule (2024)
documents.why_included: The final rule preamble; long analytical prose with compliance deadlines and cost estimates.

documents.title: Public Transportation Agency Safety Plans - Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (2023)
documents.why_included: The proposal that preceded the final rule; overlaps it heavily, which is useful for producing confidently-scored wrong retrievals.

documents.title: National Public Transportation Safety Plan (2024)
documents.why_included: National safety performance measures for transit, including the fatality, injury, safety-event and reliability measures.

documents.title: General Directive 24-1: Required Actions Regarding Assaults on Transit Workers
documents.why_included: A short, highly specific directive; its requirements appear in no other document in the corpus.

documents.title: NTSB/RIR-22/07 - Collision Between Sacramento Regional Transit District Light Rail Vehicles
documents.why_included: A complete single-incident investigation: date, milepost, injury count and probable cause exist only in this document.

documents.title: NTSB/RIR-23/15 - Derailment of Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority Train 407
documents.why_included: A second single-incident investigation with a mechanical (rather than procedural) probable cause, for contrast.
